newsitem.title: USA: First Michigan says did not initiate talks.
newsitem.headline: First Michigan says did not initiate talks.

text.p: First Michigan Bank Corp, which earlier Wednesday reported it had been in merger talks which were later terminated, said it had not initiated the talks and is not in merger discussions with other companies.
"This process was not initiated by us," a spokesman for the bank said. He said due to a confidentiality agreement he could not disclose the name of the other company.
As the industry is consolidating, the spokesman said, the company is approached by other companies from time to time.
"Most (inquiries) you can ignore," the spokesman said. "In this case it was one the board thought it could not ignore in fairness to its shareholders."
The spokesman said the companies do not expect to resume merger discussions.
As of June 30, 1996, First Michigan reported assets of $3.3 billion. The spokesman said the company currently owns 14 banks and has 86 banking locations.
